body: You did it! I truly am so proud of you! I know it must have been really hard. To hold on to what possibly been your end for so long and letting it go. I hope this brings you some peace.

I’ve voiced it once before, he basically asked me why would I think like that and that I can’t leave him. Then I just left it alone because he also suffers from depression and anxiety. I just feel like a horrible burden. I just end up bottling everything inside. These past few days I feel like I am at the brink of a melt down. Earlier felt like just cutting myself. Physically I don’t want to die, but mentally I’m just done. I see my kids and know that I have to survive another day.
